player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I did not track the location of the book after placing it in the cupboard; I assumed it was still in my inventory when I tried to put it in the wardrobe, and I wasted turns trying to find a "shelf" that didn't exist in the bedroom. Next time, I will immediately verify the current location of all items in my inventory before attempting to place them. Specifically, after putting the book in the cupboard, I will go to the kitchen, take the book back out, and then proceed to the bedroom to place it in the wardrobe. I will also scan the room description carefully for the correct destination name (e.g., "shelf" vs. "table") before issuing a "put" command.
